title: ShredDoubleEngine - V=4 voice array, voice-count switching with masked crossfade, masterSeed/Re-roll seeding, shared-LP assembly, dry-align, latency-mode buffer repoint
description:
Implement Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.h and Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.cpp — the DSP orchestrator per ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §§3, 4.1, 4.6–4.10, 7, 8.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/Voice.h (b.4 processSample / reseed / mute / getters)
- Source/DSP/MeterTap.h (c.2 API: process block/samples, setVoiceDrift, seed-independent)
- Source/DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover.h, WidthProcessor.h, DelayLineFrac.h (reused)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h, PluginProcessor.h spine members that will host the engine
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md signal flow §3 and §§4.1, 4.6–4.10, 7, 8

Implement class ShredDoubleEngine:
1. Owns fixed V=4 Voice voices[4]; one MonoSafetyCrossover; one WidthProcessor; dry-align DelayLineFrac (or equivalent delay for stereo dry PDC alignment, capacity ≥ Studio L/2 headroom / max block); one MeterTap meter; uint64_t masterSeed; current latencyMode, voiceCount (2 or 4), sampleRate.
2. prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, latencyMode): prepare all voices (worst-case Studio buffers and 35 ms delay), crossover, width, dry-align (≥ max PDC samples), meter; call seed(masterSeed); no process-path allocation afterward.
3. seed(uint64_t s): store masterSeed; for each voice reseed(s) via Voice API (splitmix64 derivation lives in walks); reset walks/means; do NOT touch std::random_device here (caller/StateManager may generate new seeds off-audio).
4. setVoiceCount(2|4): when switching to 2, ramp/mute voices 3–4 with a short masked crossfade (~10 ms) — never realloc or destroy Voice objects (D6). When switching to 4, ramp them back in.
5. setLatencyMode(Studio|Live): repoint/pre-select already-prepared PitchShifter / buffer sizes via Voice::setLatencyMode; resize only abstractions that remain within preallocated capacity; masked ~10 ms crossfade on mode switch; report latency samples as L/2 (Studio L=2048 → 1024; Live L=512 → 256) via getter used by processor setLatencySamples (D9).
6. process(float* inL, float* inR, float* outL, float* outR, int n, params): per sample or vectorized-safe inner loop:
   - mono source x = 0.5f*(L+R) if stereo else L (§4.1)
   - dry stereo advanced through dry-align delay by reported PDC samples
   - clear wetL/wetR accumulators; for each active voice: processSample(x, &wetL, &wetR) with pans already on Voice
   - MonoSafetyCrossover shared-LP from dry mono x into both channels; independent HP of wet L and wet R; invert HP polarity as ShredWidth/shared crossover requires; assemble mono-safe wet (§4.7)
   - WidthProcessor M/S width on assembled wet
   - equal-gain dry/wet mix against delayed dry; apply outTrim linear gain if provided
   - MeterTap: push final stereo out; publish per-voice tau_v / deltaC_v atomics at hop rate via Voice getters
7. Block-rate setters: spreads, pans, humanRate/tightness, monoXover coeffs/Hz, width, mix, outTrim, bypass. If bypass true, pass delayed-or-true input per contractor choice documented as true-bypass sample-exact after latency.
8. RT contract: process path noexcept-friendly; no locks, String, malloc/new, or random_device.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY allowed_write_paths. MeterTap is owned by c.2 — include and use it; do not reimplement metering inside the engine file beyond calling MeterTap. Do not edit PluginProcessor or CMakeLists (c.3).
acceptance_criteria: ShredDoubleEngine owns a fixed array of 4 Voice objects, MonoSafetyCrossover, WidthProcessor, dry-align delay, MeterTap, and masterSeed
seed(uint64) reseeds all voices and resets walks without calling std::random_device
setVoiceCount ramps/mutes voices 3-4 with masked crossfade and never reallocates Voice storage
setLatencyMode repoints preallocated latency resources with masked crossfade and exposes latency samples L/2 for Studio/Live
process path: mono source fan-out to voices, shared-LP mono-safety assembly, WidthProcessor, equal-gain dry/wet vs PDC-aligned dry, MeterTap push
No allocation, lock, String, or random_device on the process path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/PluginProcessor.* or CMakeLists.txt (owned by c.3)
modify Voice/RandomWalk/AllpassChain/TiltFilter or the eight reused ShredWidth files
call std::random_device inside seed() or process()

allowed: stereo dry-align via one or two DelayLineFrac or ring buffers preallocated in prepare
params struct or individual setters for block-rate controls
masked crossfade gain ramps for voiceCount and latencyMode switches
forbidden: allocate or free Voice/PitchShifter buffers on the audio thread
move MonoSafetyCrossover ownership into each Voice
implement GUI or PluginProcessor processBlock in this task
